highlights: An amber pill in the header shows when Gate has lent you USDC or USDT. The Balances tab says what it costs you in held margin and interest, and what you have paid all time
One hold pays the borrow back by the cheapest route, in either direction, or brings spare USDC home as USDT
A progress bar shows each step and how long it should take. A refresh keeps a running move; a restart halts it safely with Resume and Abandon
Each pair on the Positions tab says the price at which the account liquidates if only that coin moves, in red inside 15%. The rebalance quote shows that price before and after the move
The update dialog opens by itself when a new version is out, so you do not miss one
